_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Ndiye Mukandi {player_id} katika mchezo wa Liar's Dice wa {num_players} mukandi.
Kanuni:
- Katika zamu yako, unaweza ama:
  1) Fanya ofa mpya na wingi mkubwa au uso wa juu (au zote mbili) kuliko ofa ya sasa; yaani '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Toa ofa ya mwisho kwa kuandika '[Call]'.

Ikiwa unatoa ofa:
  - Ikiwa hesabu halisi ya adili ya uso wa ndenge kati ya ndenge zote ni chini ya ofa, mtoa ofa wa mwisho anapoteza ndenge moja.
  - Vinginevyo, mtoa ofa anapoteza ndenge moja.
Mukandi anayefikia ndenge 0 anashindwa. Mukandi wa mwisho anayebaki anashinda.

board.new_round:
Mvula mpya - Mafuta yamaboko: {dice_summary}
Mafuta yako yamaboko ni: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mukandi {current_player_id} anatoa ofa! Hesabu halisi ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni CHINI ya {quantity}.
Mukandi {loser_id} (mtoa ofa wa mwisho) anapoteza ndenge moja.
call.caller_loses:
Mukandi {current_player_id} anatoa ofa! Hesabu halisi ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni >= {quantity}.
Mukandi {loser_id} (mtoa ofa) anapoteza ndenge moja.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: O muthu ua kexile mu uixana, ka zuela se nanhi a mu bhana o kitadi.
invalid_move.invalid_bid: O kitadi kia bhana ki kiexile kia kidi: {reason}
invalid_move.not_recognized: Hatua haijatambuliwa kama ofa halali '[Bid: X, Y]' au '[Call]'. Hatua iliyotolewa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Wingi mpya {new_quantity} ni chini ya {current_quantity} ya sasa.
bid_reason.face_lower: Adili mpya ya uso {new_face_value} ni chini ya {current_face_value} ya sasa.
bid_reason.identical: O kitadi kia bhana, ki sokela ni kima kiala na-kiu o muthu.
bid_reason.face_range: O itambuijilu ia tokala i kala bhu kaxi ka 1 ni 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: O mu jokala {player_id} a mu katula o kididi mukonda dia ku kamba nguzu.
